# CAMR

> One memory on a Mac that every AI model the person uses shares: their notes, documents and linked code, and a
> Ledger of the decisions made with their models and why, reached by any program as an MCP server (`camr mcp <vault>`).

- [CAMR.md](https://github.com/Satasdin/CAMR/blob/burrow/CAMR.md): every MCP tool, terminal command and app page in one file
- [Skills for agents](https://github.com/Satasdin/CAMR/tree/burrow/skills): how an agent should use CAMR
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Satasdin/CAMR/blob/burrow/skills/AGENTS.md): the skills on one page, for an instructions file
- [Tool reference](https://github.com/Satasdin/CAMR/blob/burrow/docs/tools.md)
- [Getting started](https://github.com/Satasdin/CAMR/blob/burrow/docs/getting-started.md)
- [Security](https://github.com/Satasdin/CAMR/blob/burrow/docs/security.md)
